subject: Inaugural Fresh Fridays: Arts Collaborative Medford
overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted the inaugural live 'Fresh Fridays Words and Music' program, featuring the leadership of the new Arts Collaborative Medford and a live musical performance. The event included community historical reflections and announcements for upcoming local seasonal events.

items.title: Introduction and Poetry Performance
items.summary: Terry Carter opened the rebranded program with reflections on arts accessibility and a performance of his poem, 'The Deep End of the Ocean.'

items.title: Arts Collaborative Medford Interview
items.summary: Regina Parkinson, Executive Director of Arts Collaborative Medford, described the new center's facilities on Mystic Avenue and its mission to support local artists through studios and community partnerships.

items.title: Community Center Historical Reflections
items.summary: Terry Carter shared personal and historical memories of the West Medford Community Center's original 'Quonset Hut' building and its role in the neighborhood.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: The center announced upcoming initiatives, including a vaccine clinic on October 16, a 'Pumpkin Smash' on November 2, and the annual Black Vendor and Holiday Fair on November 23.

items.title: Lydia Harrell Musical Performance
items.summary: Vocalist Lydia Harrell and multi-instrumentalist Shindig performed a set of original music and soul and folk covers by artists including Stevie Wonder and Billie Holiday.
